run.name: DXP Enterprises Inc
run.title: CP-OS host session (DXPE)
run.summary: DXP is moderately leveraged and improving, with strong liquidity and a distant maturity. Acquisition spending, unhedged floating-rate debt and unusually low cash taxes are the swing factors, so the credit view is acceptable with monitoring. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is DXP ENTERPRISES INC.

revenue.basis: Sales, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA (company), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt 839,525 and cash 218,834 at September 30, 2026 (Q3 10-Q pages 2 and 11). LTM Adjusted EBITDA 254,413 = 225,302 + 195,444 - 166,333. Not pro forma; covenant EBITDA headline is 270,000 (Q3 release page:2).

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. 254,413 over 58,803 = 53,698 + 45,330 - 40,225 (Q3 10-Q page:19). On interest expense (66,455 LTM) the ratio is 3.83x. Cash interest is a year-to-date disclosure only, so LTM is spliced from three filings.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash 218,834; capacity 225,000 less letters of credit 32,829 = 192,171 (Q3 10-Q page:33); company states liquidity of 411.0 US$m, equal to the sum. Availability is printed as capacity less letters of credit; the borrowing base is not printed. No facility expires within twelve months.

cashflow.basis: Net cash from operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant EBITDA is unreconciled to reported Adjusted EBITDA, and ownership and restricted payment capacity are undocumented.
CP-1 main limitation: Leverage uses company-defined Adjusted EBITDA; the covenant EBITDA bridge and the covenant level for two quarter-ends are unresolved.
